publisher_context: HAWAI‘I Magazine attributes the 1946 Hilo Harbor Pier 1 wave and arrow-marked person photograph to NOAA; actual referenced JPEG rendered in the web viewer on 2026-10-30.

primary_source_links.noaa_catalog_description: Tsunami inundating Hilo, Hawaii. Note man on pier.

identity_evidence.limitations: NOAA PDF reproduction has a decorative wave emblem and its own crop, while the magazine JPG is differently cropped. Matching scene/arrow and catalog wording are strong identity evidence but not a byte-for-byte comparison or live-site loaded-image test. The original NOAA catalog landing page returned 503 via one web-viewer attempt, despite indexed metadata; verify official downloadable image directly before any replacement.

reuse_and_hosting.reason: Published NOAA/NGDC and Pacific Tsunami Museum joint credit does not establish whether every contributor's rights and endorsement/attribution conditions are clear for republication.
